## What will fight you

The knife edge is the precision interface of the entire machine and it is the top-vertex ridge of a hex trunnion cantilevered 21.717 mm past each end of a casting-shaped organic lever. Strongly consider a separate hardened tool-steel insert. The cast-versus-fabricate-versus-hog decision must be made **before** you buy stock.
